ex.s: Throughout the colonial period, tobacco was used in lieu of coins or paper bills in Virginia, Maryland and North Carolina, even though it was used elsewhere in the colonies and extensively throughout Europe and the UK
ex.t: 在整个殖民时期，在弗吉尼亚、马里兰和北卡罗来纳，烟草被用来代替硬币或纸币，尽管它在其他殖民地以及欧洲和英国也被广泛使用。

ex.s: Tobacco was used as coins or paper bills in American in the past.
ex.t: 过去在美国，烟草曾被当作硬币或纸币使用。

ex.t: 一位当地农夫告诉他们这只狗听起来像当地报纸上报道的一只丢失的狗。

defs.def: pieces of paper with writing on them, such as letters, pieces of work or private documents 文件；文献

ex.s: Among the bag makers' argument: many cities with bans still allow shoppers to purchase paper bags, which are easily recycled but require more energy to produce and transport.
ex.t: 在塑料袋生产商的说法中还提到：许多实施禁令的城市仍允许购物者购买纸袋，纸袋易于回收，但生产和运输耗能更多。

ex.s: Plastic, Paper or Neither
ex.t: 塑料、纸张，还是都不要

ex.s: As someone noted in this paper a couple of weeks ago, they eat great food and never gain weight.
ex.t: 正如几周前有人在这篇文章中指出，它们吃得很香却从不长胖。

ex.s: Consult a paper dictionary.
ex.t: 查阅纸质词典。

ex.s: When reading texts of several hundred words or more, learning is generally more successful when it’s on paper than onscreen.
ex.t: 阅读几百词或更长的文本时，在纸上学习通常比在屏幕上更成功。

ex.s: A company ____44____ (represent) wrote back and told me the airline was switching over _____45_____ plastic to paper cups on all of its 1,200 daily flights.
ex.t: 一家____44____（代表/represent）公司给我回信，告诉我该航空公司正在将其全部1200个每日航班上的_____45_____塑料杯换成纸杯。

defs.def: official documents that prove your identity, give you permission to do sth, etc. 证明；证件
a set of exam questions on a particular subject; the answers that people write to the questions 试卷；试题；答卷

ex.s: Some instructors choose to put previous test papers on library reserve,  making them available to all students.
ex.t: 一些教师选择把以往的试卷放在图书馆馆藏中，让所有学生都能查阅。

ex.s: I was frightened at the sight of the test paper.
ex.t: 看到试卷我吓了一跳。

ex.s: When I got the paper back, I found my teacher had written the comment "Not bad!" Not bad?
ex.t: 当我拿回试卷时，发现老师写了评语＂还不错！＂还不错？

ex.s: We could also say I was very nervous when I saw the test paper.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：当我看到试卷时我非常紧张。

defs.def: an academic article about a particular subject that is written by and for specialists 论文

ex.s: Writing was so difficult and painful for me that my teacher had allowed me to present my paper on the sinking of the Titanic by acting out a play, where I played all the parts.
ex.t: 写作对我来说太困难、太痛苦了，以至于老师允许我用表演戏剧的方式来呈现我关于泰坦尼克号沉没的论文，由我扮演所有角色。

ex.s: Writing was so difficult and painful for me that my teacher had allowed me to present my paper on the sinking of the Titanic by acting out a play, where I played all the parts.
ex.t: 写作对我来说太困难、太痛苦了，以至于老师允许我用表演戏剧的方式来呈现我关于泰坦尼克号沉没的论文，由我扮演所有角色。

ex.s: I once wrote a paper on the influence of fairy tales on Roald Dahl's writing and it gave me a new appreciation for his strange and delightful words.
ex.t: 我曾经写过一篇关于童话故事对罗尔德·达尔写作影响的论文，这让我对他奇特而美妙的文字有了新的欣赏。

ex.s: “Some nights my heart was breaking to have to pick between my kids and studying for exams or papers,” she says.
ex.t: 有些晚上我要在孩子、备考和写论文之间做选择，心都要碎了。

ex.s: Working on a paper.
ex.t: 在写论文。

ex.s: On March 7, 1907, the English statistician Francis Galton published a paper which illustrated what has come to be known as the “wisdom of crowds” effect.
ex.t: 1907年3月7日，英国统计学家弗朗西斯·高尔顿发表了一篇论文，阐述了后来被称为“群体智慧”效应的现象。

ex.s: By what time did John plan to finish his term paper?
ex.t: John计划什么时候完成学期论文？

ex.s: In order to   50  the class, among other criteria, we had to write a paper on how we plan to 51 what we would learn in class to our future professions and,   52  , to our lives.
ex.t: 为了____50____这门课，除其他标准外，我们必须写一篇论文，说明我们计划如何将课堂上学到的知识应用到未来的职业中，以及____52____我们的生活中。

ex.s: I spent days preparing and writing my first English paper.
ex.t: 我花了好几天准备和撰写我的第一篇英语论文。

ex.s: But there weren't any errors in my paper.
ex.t: 但我的论文里没有任何错误。

defs.def: a piece of written work done by a student （学生的）研究报告，论文

ex.s: 19.Why should the students avoid mixing liquid with paper?
ex.t: 19.学生为什么应避免把液体和纸混在一起？

ex.s: A research paper.
ex.t: 一篇研究论文。

defs.def: paper that you use to cover and decorate the walls of a room 壁纸

ex.s: You may use both the front and back of the paper.
ex.t: 你可以使用纸的正反两面。

ex.s: They hope paper bags will be banned someday too and want shoppers to use the same reusable bags for years.
ex.t: 他们希望纸袋有一天也能被禁用，并希望购物者多年来重复使用同样的环保袋。

ex.s: Should you come across waste paper thrown out of a passing car, pick it up.
ex.t: 如果你看到从路过车里扔出的废纸，捡起来。

ex.s: Just a specially printed piece of paper and hemp that we've assigned value to — and probably less durable over time than those shells.
ex.t: 只是一张特制的纸和大麻，我们赋予了它价值——而且随着时间推移可能还不如那些贝壳耐用。

defs.def: when you put sth on paper, you write it down 写下来；笔录

ex.s: Is comprehension the same whether a person reads a text onscreen or on paper?
ex.t: 一个人在屏幕上读文章和在纸上读文章，理解效果是一样的吗？

ex.s: The differences between print and digital reading results are partly related to paper’s physical properties.
ex.t: 纸质阅读与电子阅读效果之间的差异，部分与纸张的物理特性有关。

ex.s: With paper, there is a literal laying on of hands, along with the visual geography of distinct pages.
ex.t: 拿着纸书时，你能实实在在地用手翻阅，还能看到一页页分明的视觉布局。

ex.s: In a journal or on a piece of paper, put the heading “Personal strengths.” ____17____ Are you caring?
ex.t: 在日记本上或一张纸上写下标题“个人优点”。____17____ 你体贴吗？

ex.s: 36   When you are first trying to think of ideas for an essay, put your pen to your paper and write nonstop for ten or fifteen minutes without letting your pen leave the paper.
ex.t: 36 当你第一次试图为作文构思时，把笔放在纸上连续写十到十五分钟，不要让笔离开纸面。

ex.s: Always keep a pencil and paper beside you. ____20____Note also the facts important for your purpose as well as anything which leads you to further research.
ex.t: 你不需要详细写下这些东西。

ex.s: ■Write by hand or type on a single sheet of paper.
ex.t: ■用手写或在一张纸上打印。

ex.s: ■On the same sheet of paper, write or type your name, address, telephone number, and birth date.
ex.t: ■在同一张纸上写下或打印你的姓名、地址、电话号码和出生日期。

ex.s: Using both sides of the paper.
ex.t: 使用纸张的两面。

ex.s: What does the man want to cut out of paper?
ex.t: 这位男士想剪纸做什么？

defs.def: judged from written information only, but not proved in practice 仅照字面看；理论上

ex.s: But it doesn't end with bottles, cans, and paper.
ex.t: 但这不止于瓶子、罐子和纸张。

ex.s: On paper, his application looked ____28____ , but the interview went badly.
ex.t: 纸面上，他的申请看起来____28____，但面试很糟糕。

to try to hide a problem or disagreement in a way that is temporary and not likely to be successful 暂时掩盖，权且掩饰（问题或分歧）

ex.s: After you hear a conversation and the question about it, read the four possible answers on your paper, and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
ex.t: 听完一段对话及相关问题后，阅读纸上四个可能的答案，判断哪个是所听问题的最佳答案。

ex.s: When you hear a question, read the four possible answers on your paper and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
ex.t: 听到问题时，阅读纸上四个可能的答案，判断哪个是所听问题的最佳答案。
